name: M'ONDUNIQ ILLUMINO PP brightening and radiance-boosting cocktail with peptides and colloidal gold
shortDescription: Professional serum for pigmented, sun-damaged, dull and uneven-toned skin – with niacinamide, vitamins C and A, peptides and colloidal gold. 10 × 3 ml.
description:
A professional cosmetic serum for the care of pigmented, sun-damaged, dull and uneven-toned skin. Its complex active-ingredient composition helps reduce the visibility of pigment spots and discoloration while supporting a more even, fresher and more radiant complexion.

The formula contains niacinamide (vitamin B3/PP), vitamins C and A, peptides, Palmaria palmata red algae extract and colloidal gold. Together, the active ingredients support skin hydration and elasticity, and complement the brightening care with anti-aging and wrinkle-smoothing effects.

faq.question: How should the cocktail be used?
faq.answer: Thoroughly cleanse and dry the skin area to be treated. Apply the product to the skin, then massage it in with gentle movements until fully absorbed. It can be used on its own or as part of a professional cosmetic treatment. No rinsing required.

faq.question: Which treatments can it be used with?
faq.answer: For professional cosmetic treatments, especially for pigmented, dull, sun-damaged or uneven-toned skin. It can also be used for microneedling treatments, oxygen infusion treatments and following microdermabrasion.

faq.question: What active ingredients does it contain?
faq.answer: Palmaria palmata red algae extract, niacinamide (vitamin B3/PP), vitamin A, Perfection Peptide P3, colloidal gold, Lactil and vitamin C.
